description: Document structure for Proposal/APOTHECARY-{slug}.md (engage-apothecary Step 7). Educational-only disclaimer appears at top AND bottom (non-suppressible). Content sections cover the de-identified scenario, the differential briefs, the mandatory red-flag advocate, and the mandatory Bayesian pre/post-test synthesis with educational learning objective.

sections.title: Educational-Only Disclaimer
sections.description: Verbatim text from resources/disclaimer.txt. Stamped at TOP of every proposal.

sections.title: Educational Scenario
sections.description: Restated de-identified hypothetical (no patient names, no specific dates/locations, no MRNs).

sections.title: Differentials Explored
sections.description: Table of differentials with one-sentence rationales.

sections.title: Differential Briefs
sections.description: One section per differential with diagnosis, mechanism, evidence-tier-weighted citations, test characteristics, contraindication reasoning.

sections.title: Red-Flag Advocate
sections.description: Must-not-miss diagnosis with sharing-features rationale, ruling-out test, consequence-of-missing severity.

sections.title: Bayesian Pre/Post-Test Synthesis
sections.description: Pre-test probabilities per differential, highest-impact test/finding, post-test probability landscape, educational learning objective.

sections.title: Educational Learning Summary
sections.description: One-paragraph summary of what this case teaches.

sections.title: Educational-Only Disclaimer
sections.description: Verbatim text from resources/disclaimer.txt. Stamped at BOTTOM of every proposal.
